zones.name: Willowfen Village
zones.subtitle: North to Sunpetal Trail · South to Rosepetal Walk · West to Bramble Orchard

npcs.name: Professor Fern
npcs.dialogue: Welcome! Head north for Sunpetal Trail and Mosswood Hollow, or west into Bramble Orchard. The island circuit will bring you home again. Register three species, win three battles, then meet Ranger Elowen in Larkspur.

zones.name: Sunpetal Trail
zones.subtitle: South to Willowfen Village · North to Mosswood Hollow

npcs.name: Meadowkeeper Iris
npcs.dialogue: The main trail bends northeast toward Reedwater. Take the northern fork for Mosswood, or follow the little flower path to the old oak. There are supplies near the quiet corners.

zones.name: Mosswood Hollow
zones.subtitle: South to Sunpetal Trail · North to Larkspur Town

npcs.name: Forester Wren
npcs.dialogue: Mosswood has four ways out. Moonwell is north, Sunpetal south, Bramble Orchard west, and Larkspur east. The narrow paths lead to a mushroom circle and a hidden campsite.

zones.name: Reedwater Crossing
zones.subtitle: South to Windmill Downs · North to Tidemere Harbor

npcs.name: Fisher Ellis
npcs.dialogue: The northern bridge leads to Larkspur. Keep east for the coast at Tidemere. Try the little island loop for water hollowings; both boardwalks reconnect with the main trail.

zones.name: Larkspur Town
zones.subtitle: South to Mosswood Hollow · North to Windmill Downs · West to Moonwell Glade · East to Fiddlehead Woods

npcs.name: Ranger Elowen
npcs.dialogue: The wildflower challenge awaits!

zones.name: Bramble Orchard
zones.subtitle: East to Willowfen Village · North to Blooming Thicket

npcs.name: Orchardkeeper Bea
npcs.dialogue: The rows of fruit trees hide a few short paths. South takes you home to Willowfen. Turn east at the apple shed to enter Mosswood and complete the woodland loop.

zones.name: Moonwell Glade
zones.subtitle: East to Larkspur Town

npcs.name: Keeper Selene
npcs.dialogue: This little glade has only one entrance, to the south. Walk the whole ring around the lake. The lights drifting between the trees are not always fireflies.

zones.name: Amberrise Bluffs
zones.subtitle: North to Petalwind Meadow · South to Ashen Switchbacks · West to Windchime Ridge

npcs.name: Climber Ash
npcs.dialogue: Follow the switchbacks up from Larkspur, then head east into Frostglass Pass. The rocky shelves cannot be crossed directly. A narrow spur leads to the old lookout.

zones.name: Frostglass Pass
zones.subtitle: North to Snowbell · South to Frostglass Lake

npcs.name: Scout Lumi
npcs.dialogue: Amberrise is west of the upper pass. Follow the snowy bends south to Windmill Downs. The frozen lake is slippery but safe to cross, unlike the deep streams below.

zones.name: Windmill Downs
zones.subtitle: South to Larkspur Town · North to Reedwater Crossing

npcs.name: Miller Rowan
npcs.dialogue: Both windmill paths circle back here. North climbs to Frostglass Pass, south descends to Tidemere, and west leads into Larkspur. The wind brings unusual air hollowings.

zones.name: Tidemere Harbor
zones.subtitle: South to Reedwater Crossing · North to Juniper Walk

npcs.name: Harbormaster Marin
npcs.dialogue: Welcome to the coast! Rest at the Healing House before taking the northern trail to Windmill Downs. The boardwalk circles the harbor; the west road follows Reedwater back inland.

npcs.dialogue: Welcome to Cedar Stair. The paths circle this area and lead to the signposted exits. Look for supplies off the main trail.
